column8: {F : Type} → [inst : Field F] → {v : ℕ} → (ℕ → Polynomial F) → (ℕ → Polynomial F) → F → F → (Fin v → F) → Prop := fun {F} [Field F] {v} prover honest H S r => (∀ i < v, Polynomial.eval 0 (prover i) + Polynomial.eval 1 (prover i) = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain H prover (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) ∧ Minidregg.Selvage.scChain H prover (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) v = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain S honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) v ∧ H ≠ S

(F : Type) → [Field F] → [Fintype F] → ℕ → ℕ → Prop := fun F [Field F] [Fintype F] v d => ∀ (bad : (Fin v → F) → Fin v → Finset F), (∀ (i : Fin v) (r r' : Fin v → F), (∀ (j : Fin v), ↑j < ↑i → r j = r' j) → bad r i = bad r' i) → (∀ (r : Fin v → F) (i : Fin v), (bad r i).card ≤ d) → (Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) fun r => ∃ i, r i ∈ bad r i) ≤ ↑v * (↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F))

{F : Type} → [inst : Field F] → {v : ℕ} → (ℕ → Polynomial F) → (ℕ → Polynomial F) → F → F → Fin v → (Fin v → F) → Prop := fun {F} [Field F] {v} prover honest H S i r => Polynomial.eval 0 (prover ↑i) + Polynomial.eval 1 (prover ↑i) = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain H prover (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) ↑i ∧ Minidregg.Selvage.scChain H prover (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) ↑i ≠ Minidregg.Selvage.scChain S honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) ↑i ∧ Polynomial.eval (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r ↑i) (prover ↑i) = Polynomial.eval (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r ↑i) (honest ↑i)

∀ {F : Type} [Field F] [inst : Fintype F] {v d : ℕ} (b : Fin v → Finset F), (∀ (i : Fin v), (b i).card ≤ d) → (Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) fun r => ∃ i, r i ∈ (fun _r => b) r i) ≤ ↑v * (↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F))
∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] {v d : ℕ}, Minidregg.Selvage.AdaptiveUnionBound F v d
{F : Type} → [inst : Field F] → [Fintype F] → [DecidableEq F] → Polynomial F → Polynomial F → Finset F
∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] [inst_2 : DecidableEq F] {d : ℕ} {p q : Polynomial F}, p.degree < ↑d → q.degree < ↑d → p ≠ q → (Minidregg.Selvage.agreeFinset p q).card < d
{F : Type} → [Field F] → {v : ℕ} → (Fin v → F) → ℕ → F
∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] {v : ℕ} (r : Fin v → F) (i : Fin v), Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r ↑i = r i

∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] {v : ℕ} {prover honest : ℕ → Polynomial F} {chal claimF truF : ℕ → F}, (∀ i < v, claimF (i + 1) = Polynomial.eval (chal i) (prover i)) → (∀ i < v, truF (i + 1) = Polynomial.eval (chal i) (honest i)) → claimF 0 ≠ truF 0 → (∀ j < v, ¬(claimF j ≠ truF j ∧ Polynomial.eval (chal j) (prover j) = Polynomial.eval (chal j) (honest j))) → ∀ i ≤ v, claimF i ≠ truF i
∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] [inst_2 : DecidableEq F] {p q : Polynomial F} {x : F}, x ∈ Minidregg.Selvage.agreeFinset p q ↔ Polynomial.eval x p = Polynomial.eval x q
{F : Type} → [inst : Field F] → F → (ℕ → Polynomial F) → (ℕ → F) → ℕ → F
∀ {F : Type} {v : ℕ} {i : Fin v} (x : ({ j // j ≠ i } → F) × F) {j : Fin v} (hj : j ≠ i), (Minidregg.Selvage.splitCoord i).symm x j = x.1 ⟨j, hj⟩

∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {d : ℕ} {g gp : Polynomial F} {H : F}, g.degree < ↑(d + 1) → gp.degree < ↑(d + 1) → Polynomial.eval 0 gp + Polynomial.eval 1 gp = H → H ≠ Polynomial.eval 0 g + Polynomial.eval 1 g → (Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb F fun r => Polynomial.eval r gp = Polynomial.eval r g) ≤ ↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F)

∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] [inst_2 : DecidableEq F] {d : ℕ} {g gp : Polynomial F} {H : F}, g.degree < ↑(d + 1) → gp.degree < ↑(d + 1) → Polynomial.eval 0 gp + Polynomial.eval 1 gp = H → H ≠ Polynomial.eval 0 g + Polynomial.eval 1 g → (Minidregg.Selvage.agreeFinset gp g).card ≤ d

∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] {v : ℕ} {prover honest : ℕ → Polynomial F} {chal claimF truF : ℕ → F}, (∀ i < v, claimF (i + 1) = Polynomial.eval (chal i) (prover i)) → (∀ i < v, truF (i + 1) = Polynomial.eval (chal i) (honest i)) → claimF 0 ≠ truF 0 → claimF v = truF v → ∃ j < v, claimF j ≠ truF j ∧ Polynomial.eval (chal j) (prover j) = Polynomial.eval (chal j) (honest j)

∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {v d : ℕ} {prover honest : ℕ → Polynomial F} {H S : F}, (∀ i < v, (prover i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ i < v, (honest i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ (r : Fin v → F), ∀ i < v, Polynomial.eval 0 (honest i) + Polynomial.eval 1 (honest i) = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain S honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) → Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) (Minidregg.Selvage.AcceptsFalse prover honest H S) ≤ ↑v * (↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F))
∀ {F : Type} [inst : Fintype F] {v : ℕ} (i : Fin v) (S : Finset F), (Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) fun r => r i ∈ S) ≤ ↑S.card / ↑(Fintype.card F)

∀ {F : Type} [Field F] [inst : Fintype F] {v d : ℕ} (i : Fin v) (bad : (Fin v → F) → Finset F), (∀ (r r' : Fin v → F), (∀ (j : Fin v), ↑j < ↑i → r j = r' j) → bad r = bad r') → (∀ (r : Fin v → F), (bad r).card ≤ d) → (Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) fun r => r i ∈ bad r) ≤ ↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F)
∀ {F : Type} [inst : Fintype F] (S : Finset F), (Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb F fun x => x ∈ S) = ↑S.card / ↑(Fintype.card F)

∀ {F : Type} [Field F] [inst : Fintype F] {v d : ℕ} (bad : Fin v → Finset F), (∀ (i : Fin v), (bad i).card ≤ d) → (Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) fun r => ∃ i, r i ∈ bad i) ≤ ↑v * (↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F))
